senses.definition: (US, Australia) A frankfurter; a hot dog sausage.

quotes.text: Sample of frankfurts procured from Stanley Kwiatkowski, Grand Rapids, Mich. Contains excessive amount of cereal.
quotes.reference: 1919, Michigan Office of Dairy and Food Commissioner, Annual report of the Dairy and Food Commissioner of the State of Michigan, volume 25, page 81:

quotes.text: Frankfurts of the highest quality are prepared generally from a mixture of approximately half beef and half pork.
quotes.reference: 1942, Robert Byron Hinman, Robert Bernard Harris, The Story of Meat, page 137:

quotes.text: As a kid in the 50s, (before we became infested with the current mish-mash of liquorice allsorts) pork fritz, devon, sliced ham, frankfurts, pork sausages...were all about as common a staple as you care to name. Even the Italians and Greeks of the time ate (and continue to eat) the stuff!!
